description: This file defines the RecipeRepository class, which manages CRUD operations and search functionality for Recipe entities in the backend. It uses in-memory concurrent data structures to store recipes and provides methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching recipes based on various filters.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing Recipe entities with in-memory storage and search capabilities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Recipe object; assigns an ID if it doesn't have one.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Recipe by its ID wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a Recipe by its ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all stored recipes.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Filters recipes based on title substring, ingredients, and tags with pagination.

methods.name: countSearch
methods.description: Returns the count of recipes matching the search criteria.
